title: Keyboard shortcuts
presetTip: Total Commander puts packing on Alt+F5, unpacking on Alt+F9 and renaming on Shift+F6, for example. Your own changes go on top.
fixed: {key} is taken for good. Pick another key.
letter: Single letters and digits belong to the quick search. Add Ctrl, Alt or an F key.
taken: {key} already belongs to “{action}”. Press it again to take the key, Esc leaves everything as it is.
hint: Click a key and press the new combination
asShipped: The shortcuts are back as shipped
